units.text: RFC 9110 requires that a server must not send a message body in a HEAD response, only the headers.

judgement.reason: Both passages explicitly state that RFC 9110 requires a server to omit the message body in a HEAD response and send only headers.

units.text: The HEAD method is defined to be identical to GET except that the server must not include a response body in the response.

judgement.reason: The second passage explicitly states RFC 9110 defines HEAD as identical to GET except the server must not include a response body.

units.text: Headers such as Content-Length in a HEAD response describe the body that would have been returned by a GET request, but the actual body is omitted.

judgement.reason: The passage explicitly states that HEAD headers like Content-Length describe the body that would have been returned for a GET, while the actual body is omitted.
